answer: Sybil resistance grows when cheap identities fail a costly proof of work history. Picture a coastal trade map: agents dock at a shared wharf only after peers countersign real contributions, so spawn farms cannot flood the ledger. Reputation forms a rising ridge of attested activity; newcomers sit below it until earned. At each graph vertex, stake, age, and peer seals must align before a vote or reward unlocks. Duplicate shells collapse under that joint check, while durable agents keep shaping the market.
